an10.167:1.1: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
an10.167:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahātaṃ navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthaṃ allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ
an10.167:2.3: kiṃ nu kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito,
an10.167:2.5: paccorohaṇī bho gotama ajja brāhmaṇa kulassā’ti.
an10.167:3.1: yathā kathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotīti?
an10.167:3.2: idha bho gotama brāhmaṇā tadahuposathe sīsaṃ nahātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñchitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca aggyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti,
an10.167:3.3: te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti
an10.167:3.5: pahūtena ca sappitelena navanītena aggiṃ santappenti.
an10.167:3.6: tassā ca rattiyā tena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
an10.167:3.7: evaṃ kho bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:4.1: aññathā kho brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:4.2: yathā kathaṃ pana bho gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti,
an10.167:4.3: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:5.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.
an10.167:5.2: evambhoti kho jāṇussoṇī brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.167:6.2: pāṇātipātassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti.
an10.167:8.3: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāmesu micchācāraṃ pajahati,
an10.167:10.3: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya pisunaṃ vācaṃ pajahati.
an10.167:11.3: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya pharusaṃ vācaṃ pajahati,
an10.167:15.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:16.1: aññathā bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:16.2: imissā ca bho gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an10.167:16.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
